name: Mahasagar Travels Limited
summary: Mahasagar Travels Limited specializes in offering passenger transportation and comprehensive tour services. Its extensive operations cover key urban centers throughout Gujarat, including Kodinar, Veraval, Somnath, Keshod, Dhoraji, Jetpur, Virpur, Gondal, Rajkot, Chotila, and Ahmedabad. Headquartered in Junagadh, India, the company was established on September 28, 1993.
